next.reason: 1985: 'S' with no SIGN clause has an operational sign, 'the implementor will define the position and representation', 'General rules 5 through 7 do not apply'. §2023:13.18.52.4 GR4: 'The implementor shall specify the position and representation of the operational sign. General rules 5 and 6 do not apply'; documented per DOC-A.1-177. Not exempting GR7 is inert: its first sentence (signed item) agrees and its conversion sentence needs a SIGN clause. Same programs, same effect.
